svg.title: Гиперэкстензия с гантелью — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. 45-degree back extension with ONE recognizable dumbbell on a full Roman-chair bench, side three-quarter view. Ankles secured under visible rollers, front upper thighs rest on pad below hip crease, hips free. Both hands hold ONE dumbbell horizontally across chest, recognizable short handle with a thick weight head at each end, never a round plate. LEFT: flex torso down at hips while pressing weight to chest. RIGHT: raise torso to a straight diagonal from ankle through hip to shoulder, no spine overextension. Feet, pad, and body position on bench unchanged. Clear dumbbell throughout. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
